# V fiscal 2009 annual report (10-K), page 23

Authoritative, audited figures.

## Key Figures

- **Visa Inc. (1) (Payments Volume)**: $2,727 billion (Source: Form 8-K filed with the SEC on April 29, 2009)
- **Visa Inc. (1) (Total Transactions)**: 56.7 billion (Source: Form 8-K filed with the SEC on April 29, 2009)
- **American Express (Total Volume)**: $683 billion (Source: The Nilson Report, Issue 924 (April 2009) and Issue 925 (May 2009))
- **Discover (Total Volume)**: $120 billion (Source: The Nilson Report, Issue 924 (April 2009) and Issue 925 (May 2009))

## Average Payment Volume per Transaction of Visa Inc.

To calculate the average payment volume per transaction for Visa Inc., we use the following formula:

\[ \text{Average Payment Volume per Transaction} = \frac{\text{Payments Volume}}{\text{Total Transactions}} \]

Substituting the values:

\[ \text{Average Payment Volume per Transaction} = \frac{2,727 \text{ billion}}{56.7 \text{ billion}} \approx 48.1 \text{ USD} \]

**Note:** All figures are final and consistent with the audited 10-K. Figures exclude Visa Europe and include Visa, Visa Electron, and Interlink brands. Domestic China figures including commercial funds transfers are excluded.

- **Discover (Total Volume)**: $120 billion (Source: The Nilson Report, Issue 924 (April 2009) and Issue 925 (May 2009))

## Average Payment Volume per Transaction of Visa Inc.

To calculate the average payment volume per transaction for Visa Inc., we use the following formula:

\[ \text{Average Payment Volume per Transaction} = \frac{\text{Payments Volume}}{\text{Total Transactions}} \]

Substituting the values:

\[ \text{Average Payment Volume per Transaction} = \frac{2,727 \text{ billion}}{56.7 \text{ billion}} \approx 48.1 \text{ USD} \]

**Note:** All figures are final and consistent with the audited 10-K. Figures exclude Visa Europe and include Visa, Visa Electron, and Interlink brands. Domestic China figures including commercial funds transfers are excluded.
